summary: Roadmap fit is fine — this is infrastructure with no Lean content, and `Roadmap: none` is the sanctioned label for it. But the PR bundles a separable ~810-line refactor of the existing dot-notation lint (extraction of `scripts/lean_source.py`, with an internal API redesign) with the new shim registry, checker, and CI wiring; ship the refactor first as its own PR.
